paragraphs.text: On 3 November, the average Air Quality Index of Delhi was 331, which falls in the 'very poor' category.
On Monday 2 November 2026, the Commission for Air Quality Management implemented the second phase of the Graded Response Action Plan in the Delhi-NCR region.
Jahangirpuri and Pusa recorded 'very poor' air quality with AQI readings of 308 and 314.
Delhi's Air Quality Index was recorded on 2 November 2026.
On Tuesday 3 November 2026, the Delhi-NCR region experienced severe air pollution levels before Diwali, and it reached a severe level before Diwali.
On Thursday 5 November 2026, the Air Quality Index crossed the 400 mark at 18 monitoring stations in Delhi.
The total AQI of Delhi was recorded at 451 at 8:00 AM on Tuesday.
Jahangirpuri recorded the highest Air Quality Index at 459.
The AQI exceeded 400 at eight monitoring stations in Delhi.
